description: Change a space as its admin: settings, access, owners, review cadence, main page (homePageId; null clears it), or archive/restore (archived). Read its revision with anyforge_list_pages and pass ifRevision; stale settings are refused with 409. The key cannot change. Access fields merge with existing settings; member/owner/team arrays replace the old arrays. Only call when the person asked for these changes.
name: anyforge_update_page_space
title: Update page space
